svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor: 50 mm board 694 x 594 (the inside of the shell), laid first.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Walls: two layers of 25 mm blanket, rigidised, 947 tall, standing

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the floor board. Cut the back and front 694 long and the two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ends 494 long, so the ends fit between them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Roof board: 50 mm board 594 x 494 with a 150 hole in the centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pinned under the roof plate (it comes off with the roof).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut through the front: door opening 300 x 240 and air inlet

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 160 x 60, lined up with the shell openings.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut through the right end: the two tube slots, 40 wide.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slot each wall where the coil brackets pass: bracket size plus 1.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hold the blanket with stainless pins welded to the shell, about

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 250 apart, and speed washers. Wear a mask: see the safety stops.
